description.value:
You were taught by someone who believed the world could be brought back, and you have not yet found the evidence that finishes the argument either way. Greenline Wardens are the ones settlements send for. They are also the ones who get told, politely, to move on once the field is producing.

While the needle is on Green, your terrain effects cover 50% more area and your healing spells restore additional Hit Points equal to your level.

7th — Deep Furrow: your [TERRAIN] spells can be cast one rank lower than normal.
15th — The Standing Grove: once per day, a [TERRAIN] effect you create also heals every ally standing in it to full as it takes root.

cinderfall.incomplete: Same treatment as Blightline: selection wiring already real (`otherTags` confirmed present, see `cutting` entry). The passive itself is doubly blocked — `BLOOMROT-NULL` for "while Green," and there is no rule element that scales a spell's *area* or a healing spell's *amount* at all (searched; no such RE key exists — area/healing-amount live in the spell's own static fields, not a modifiable derived stat). The 7th (cast one rank lower) sub-feature matches Splinter Faith's real precedent for a rank-reduction claim that ships `rules:[]` (P9) even in real published content; the 15th (once/day full heal) is frequency-gated bucket 3 plus `BLOOMROT-NULL`.
